column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/stage_order_values.onsa tests=9 evaluated=9 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ the arm of a match~ that calls an instance in the first argument of a delay counts on every sample, the binding of an arm not taken is 0
render stage_order_values.enum_arm_in_delay sr=0x41000000 params p=2 in k=[1 3 2 5 4]
@ the same in a par~: each replica has the state of its own
render stage_order_values.enum_arm_in_delay_par sr=0x41000000 params p=2 in k=[1 3 2 5 4]
@ a par~ in the first argument of a delay keeps a state for each replica and the delay gives the array of the sample before
render stage_order_values.par_in_delay sr=0x41000000 in k=[1 2 3 4]
@ a call with an output at sample / 4 in the first argument of a delay is delayed by a tick of sample / 4 and read held
render stage_order_values.delayed_slow_call sr=0x41000000 params one=1 frames=12
@ a child of the init stage and a child of the block stage with a hoisted block part below them
render stage_order_values.init_and_block_children sr=0x41000000 cfg c=3 params p=4 frames=3
@ a child that nothing reads does not stop the first sample: its delay holds the 1 of its first value
render stage_order_values.unread_child sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=1
out=[7]
@ a child that nothing reads runs on every sample: it divides by the 0 of its delay at the frame 1
render stage_order_values.unread_child sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=2
panic sample 1
@ a let that nothing reads is evaluated: the same division at the frame 1
render stage_order_values.unread_let sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=1
out=[7]
render stage_order_values.unread_let sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=2
panic sample 1
@ a child of sample / 4 that nothing reads runs at its ticks: 4 frames pass, the tick at the frame 4 divides by 0
render stage_order_values.unread_slow_child sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=4
render stage_order_values.unread_slow_child sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=5
panic sample 4
